after.label: Data bits after label and parity
after.description: Source-backed word/channel constraint; actual device, ICD and schedule evidence remains separate.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Up to 23 bits after mandatory label/parity; at most 21 with SDI or SSM and 19 with both. BNR sign/resolution requires actual ICD.

after.label: Channel direction
after.description: Source-backed word/channel constraint; actual device, ICD and schedule evidence remains separate.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: One channel is simplex. Return traffic needs another independent channel.

after.label: Actual transmitter fall time
after.description: Source-backed word/channel constraint; actual device, ICD and schedule evidence remains separate.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual fall time: LOW 5..15 microseconds, HIGH 1..2. Unknown device value; rate and mode constraints both apply.

after.label: Minimum NULL gap between words
after.description: Source-backed word/channel constraint; actual device, ICD and schedule evidence remains separate.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: At least four NULL bit times between words; chosen gap and rates still require actual schedule evidence.

after.label: ICD label (decimal value of 8-bit label)
after.description: Source-backed word/channel constraint; actual device, ICD and schedule evidence remains separate.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Eight-bit identifier, entered as decimal 0..255; literature labels are conventionally octal. Assignment comes from ICD, no default label.

after.label: Word parity
after.description: Source-backed word/channel constraint; actual device, ICD and schedule evidence remains separate.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Odd parity bit, error detection without built-in correction; actual encoding is not implemented by an identity codec.

after.label: Actual sinks on this channel
after.description: Source-backed word/channel constraint; actual device, ICD and schedule evidence remains separate.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual 1..20 receiving sinks per channel; no invented number of configured receivers.

after.label: Actual transmitter rise time
after.description: Source-backed word/channel constraint; actual device, ICD and schedule evidence remains separate.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Actual rise time: LOW 5..15 microseconds, HIGH 1..2. Unknown device value; rate and mode constraints both apply.

after.label: Optional Source/Destination Identifier
after.description: Source-backed word/channel constraint; actual device, ICD and schedule evidence remains separate.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Optional two-bit SDI, no LRU address invention. If used, it reduces the available data bits by two.

after.label: ARINC channel speed mode
after.description: Source-backed word/channel constraint; actual device, ICD and schedule evidence remains separate.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: One low or high mode on a simplex channel; proposed LOW is not actual-link confirmation.

after.label: Sign/Status Matrix code
after.description: Source-backed word/channel constraint; actual device, ICD and schedule evidence remains separate.

parameter_reviews.meaning_and_applicability_review: Two-bit SSM code; its meaning depends on BNR/BCD/discrete format, so no generic normal-state default. If used, reduces data bits by two.
